<!-- pr-reviewer: 981e4ebe7e875df782e2c078579d0323c5a76916 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good
- The picks edit only the page draft (`op_ui.params`). Apply stores them with the existing `EditOperationParams`, so undo works. No new command, so no MCP tool is owed.
- The ui layer makes no flecs calls. The pick state is view state only.
- A face or an edge click, a flat lower point, a lost vertex, a non-finite vertex and a full pair list are each refused by name and change nothing (`wire_sync_pick.rs` `take`).
- No snapshot PNG changed. The new files are under 400 lines. A decision file is included.

Results merged with main (locally, no Actions run)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib wire_`: 13 passed, 0 failed. This includes both new tests.
- `structural`, `points_pick`, `vertex_pick`, `feature_click` filters: 19 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Mutation check: I disabled the "lower point must lie below" test in `wire_sync_pick.rs`. `two_clicked_corners_state_a_sync_pair_and_a_flat_one_is_refused` failed at `wire_sync_viewport.rs:57`. I restored the file.

Requested before merge
- None.

Notes (not blocking)
- `wire_page.rs:167` and `:172` use a raw `ui.button` and `ui.label`. `crates/ui/AGENTS.md` ("Form seam") asks for the form helpers. The rest of this page already does the same, and I found no limits test for this page. Move it with the page family in #1122.
- `state.rs` is 4477 lines and grows by 4. It was already over the limit.
- The pick stays armed when the user closes the page or opens another operation. The next vertex click then stops it with a message. A disarm on page change would be cleaner.

Not exercised
- The GUI was not launched. Pixel snapshots were not run. The full ui suites and other OS arms were not run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
